guideline: Annotators rate dialogs based on incoherence problems for global coherence, and responses for local appropriateness (0 if inappropriate, 1 otherwise) and informativeness (0 if safe response, 1 otherwise).
Annotators rate each dialog or utterance on criteria such as global coherence, local appropriateness, and informativeness.

A session will be rated "0" if it contains more than three incoherence cases, or "+1" if a session contains 2 or 3 cases, otherwise "+2". Local appropriateness: A response will be rated "0" if it is inappropriate as an reply to the given message, otherwise "1". Informativeness: "0" if a response is a "safe" response, e.g. "I don't know", otherwise "1".
